findings.location: “It’s her drinking!” Her husband told me. “She is drinking more and more every night. She won’t go out except to get whiskey. She drinks till she passes out every night and has to have something every morning to get her started.”
findings.source_quote: “She won’t go out except to get whiskey.”

findings.location: When dealing with someone who drinks heavily, it is crucial that they don’t simply stop drinking without medical support. Abrupt cessation of alcohol use causes the body to go into withdrawal which can produce a state called Delirium Tremens and even seizures.
findings.source_quote: Abrupt cessation of alcohol use causes the body to go into withdrawal which can produce a state called Delirium Tremens and even seizures.
findings.suggested_fix:
Correct the Kiswahili medical terminology and preserve meaning. Replace the translated sentence text (inside the same

element) with: “Ni muhimu kwamba mtu anayekunywa pombe kwa wingi asilieache ghafla bila msaada wa matibabu. Kuacha ghafla matumizi ya pombe husababisha mwili kuingia katika dalili za kuondolewa ambazo zinaweza kusababisha hali inayoitwa Delirium Tremens na hata kifafa (seizures).”
findings.translation_quote: “Kuacha kabisa matumizi ya pombe husababisha mwili kuingia katika dalili za kuondolewa ambazo zinaweza kusababisha hali inayoitwa Delirium Tremens na hata kufichua (seizures).”

findings.location: It seems there is little point of investing ourselves in the people around us. They are full of woe and are as likely to change as a chipmunk is to master differential calculus.
findings.source_quote: They are full of woe and are as likely to change as a chipmunk is to master differential calculus.
findings.suggested_fix:
Localize the simile to a natural Kiswahili expression or provide a common animal name in Kiswahili. For example: replace “kama chipmunk akifanikisha hesabu tofauti” with “kama chipmunk (au jerboa/squirrel) akifanikiwa kujifunza hesabu ngumu,” or choose a commonly understood small mammal in Kiswahili. Keep the

element intact.
findings.translation_quote: “Wamejaa huzuni na wana uwezekano mdogo wa kubadilika kama chipmunk akifanikisha hesabu tofauti.”
